data.name: Film Look for Tarkov (ReShade Preset)
data.teaser: This is NOT your typical "ciNeMAtiC" ReShade pack. This is a zero performance impact, gameplay focused color correction alternative to FPS-killing POSTFX, done by a professional movie colorist, that substantially enhances vanilla aesthetics.
data.description:
Absolutely ZERO DoF, Bloom, Vignetting, hypercontrast or exaggerated colors bullshit.

This is comparatively tame color correction preset made with most sophisticated grading and film emulation tools in the industry.

Unlike built-in POSTFX (insane -20 FPS in my case), this has zero performance impact because it uses pre-baked custom LUT and minimal amount of extremely fast shaders (1.3ms on GTX1080. Disable optional LumaSharpen and FilmGrain for a sick 0.45ms preset, that’s like taking 1 out of 2220 FPS).

It tries to strike the balance between gameplay focused features like oversaturation for target acquisition and clarity, proper black levels/contrast, and pleasantly augmenting vanilla look.

Adjust your saturation levels based on preference/your monitor calibration in prod80_04_ContrastBrightnessSaturation node, or disable it completely.

Saturation (linear, global adjustment of color intensity) Recommendation: -0.200 for closer to vanilla look, -0.100 for “mild” preset, leave at 0 for my very colorful defaults.

Vibrance (makes less saturated colors more, well, vibrant… Non-linear adjustment by nature)

Aesthetically it kinda fits Amands’s Graphics default preset, but it was not graded with it in mind, I’m really not a huge fan of it anyway because it changes Tarkov vanilla look way too much for my taste (which I personally really like), maybe I will look into making a proper custom preset for it in the future.

New in V2:

Now includes 3 presets (default V2 or V2-FakeGI-AmbientLight or V1).

- New V2 color correction, much more vibrant green colors, less yellows.

- New optional preset with Fake Global Illumination and Ambient Light shaders. This one is slightly more demanding, but IMO looks the best. Change in Reshade menu with HOME button.

- Now includes ReShade 6.3.3 dll and ini settings for easier installation, just drag and drop to root SPT folder.

Installation:

1. Unzip the archive and put it in root folder of you SPT installation. (dxgi.dll, ODT-FilmLook-V2-Default.ini and “reshade-shaders” folder should be at EscapeFromTarkov.exe level).

You have to make sure that the files are located like this:

%SPT-INSTALL-DIRECTORY%\**dxgi.dll

%SPT-INSTALL-DIRECTORY%\ODT-FilmLook-V2-Default.ini

%SPT-INSTALL-DIRECTORY%\reshade-shaders\

Installation example is under the spoiler:

2. ReShade dll is now included in zip file, no need to download it separately. Virustotal link for the release.

3. Start your game.

3.1 Press HOME button to open ReShade configuration window and choose your preset (V2 or V2-FakeGI-AmbientLight or V1).

3.4 DISABLE YOUR POSTFX OPTIONS

Uninstall:

Delete dxgi.dll.
